subject.title: [Bug]: PolicyFixMetadata inheritance silently drops custom checkId fields

question: Should policy doctor fix metadata support custom extension-provided `checkId`/`fixClass` inheritance, or is this table intentionally private to the bundled policy plugin?
rationale: Current source does not prove the reported runtime drop, and accepting the request would define a new policy/security extension contract rather than a narrow existing bug fix.

options.title: Keep Metadata Private
options.body: Treat this as a private bundled-policy table and ask for a concrete supported extension contract before changing the helper.

options.title: Design A Policy Metadata Seam
options.body: Define a documented plugin or policy API for custom fix metadata and add compatibility tests around custom IDs and fix classes.

options.title: Permit Local Helper Overrides
options.body: Allow identity overrides only for internal table construction if maintainers want that flexibility without exposing it as an extension API.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Private
recommendation.body: Treat this as a private bundled-policy table and ask for a concrete supported extension contract before changing the helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the owner-boundary question for this policy metadata surface and are the clearest routing candidate for the API-contract decision in the available discussion.
